labels.ai_t: So what is the AI behind it, really?
ai: It reads and writes text, like a very fast person who never gets tired. That’s all it does. It doesn’t “think” for you or decide anything on its own.
The rules are ours and yours. We design what happens in each situation. You approve every text it can send. It picks from approved replies: it doesn’t make up prices or promises.
It runs on your accounts. The WhatsApp is yours, the diary is yours, the Google profile is yours. Customer data stays where it already was.
Everything is logged: every message sent, at what time, to whom and what they replied. You can read it all, whenever you like.
When things go off-script, a person steps in. A question it doesn’t know, an upset customer, an odd request: it reaches you or us, with the whole conversation.

itens.durere: Customers call when we’re full and I can’t pick up. At night I find twelve missed calls and no idea who wanted what.
pasi: The customer writes on WhatsApp or calls. A missed call automatically gets a message within seconds.
The assistant replies right away: opening hours, menu or prices, address, bookings. In your business’s voice.
Whatever it doesn’t know, it sends to you, with the whole conversation, so you can answer with one tap.
Every customer goes into your list, with what they asked.
itens.obtii: No customer left without an answer, day and night. You only step in when a person is needed.
itens.nevoie: WhatsApp Business and the list of questions you hear most.

itens.titlu: The customers who didn’t come back
itens.durere: I only see the new customers. The old ones, who haven’t been in for three months, I know nothing about. And they don’t hear from me either.
pasi: Every customer you’ve talked to or who booked goes into your list, with the date of their last visit.
After 60 days without a visit, they get a personal message, from you. Not an ad.
On their birthday, a small gesture: a dessert, a discount or a simple “happy birthday”.
Whoever comes back is marked. Whoever doesn’t want more messages leaves the list with a single word.
itens.obtii: Old customers come back without you paying for ads to bring them back.
itens.nevoie: The customer list (the other automations build it) and WhatsApp Business.

privacidade.intro: What personal data we collect on pachecost.com and ro.pachecost.com, why, and how you can ask to see or delete it.

secoes.p: The sites pachecost.com and ro.pachecost.com belong to Pacheco Studios, a digital studio founded by Tomás Pacheco in Portugal. For anything related to privacy, write to tomas@pachecost.com.

This site is static: it has no accounts, no forms and no cookies of its own. We only process personal data when you contact us yourself, by WhatsApp, phone or email: your name, your contact details and what you write, used only to reply and follow up on your request.
The site is hosted by Netlify. Like any server, it logs technical data, such as your IP address and the date and time of access, for security and operation.

We use GoatCounter to count visits, scans of the QR code on our business card, and clicks to WhatsApp and phone. It uses no cookies, doesn’t store your IP address and can’t identify anyone, so it works without asking for consent.

secoes.t: Meta pixel, only with your consent
secoes.p: On pachecost.com, if you tap “Accept” on the banner shown on your first visit, we load the Meta pixel (Facebook and Instagram). It sets cookies and tells Meta you visited this site, so we can measure our ads. If you choose “Essentials only”, the pixel is never loaded. There is no pixel on ro.pachecost.com. You can change your mind by clearing this site’s data in your browser.
The project names use fonts from Google Fonts. When you open the page, your browser requests them from Google’s servers, which receive your IP address.
Messages are kept only as long as needed to follow up on your request or to meet legal obligations, such as invoicing. We never sell or hand over data to third parties.

You can ask at any time for access to your data, a correction, a copy or its deletion: just write to tomas@pachecost.com. You can also complain to the data protection authority in your country, or to Portugal’s CNPD.
